fieldsThisFormatCannotExpress.address: Profile.address is an embedded Address document. The declaration above says String because that is the nearest thing JDL has: its field vocabulary (generator-jhipster/jdl/jhipster/field-types.js, CommonDBTypes) is scalar only, and a MongoDB relationship would emit a DBRef into another collection rather than an embedded object. Regenerating Profile emits String and breaks every consumer of the nested fields.
fieldsThisFormatCannotExpress.emergencyContact: Profile.emergencyContact is an embedded EmergencyContact, which is a value type with no @Document, no repository and no definition file of its own. Same reason as address: there is no JDL for it, and the String above is an approximation rather than a description.
fieldsThisFormatCannotExpress.teamIds: Profile.teamIds is a List<String>. JDL has no collection-of-scalar field type at all, so the String above understates it by one dimension. Regenerating Profile emits String, and a clinician stops being able to belong to more than one team.
